page_title: WOL 1-1 AUG | Wolfsburg v Augsburg 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' It looks like Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) saw red with that tackle. Felix Brych won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Augsburg will take a free kick.
90+2' The ball has crossed the sideline. Wolfsburg are taking a throw-in.
90+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg).
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
87' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Brych had an easy-decision to make.
84' The attendance is 25000.
82' 1 - 1 Goal! Joakim Maehle slips it to Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) on the edge of the box and he finds the top right corner with a great effort. The score is 1:1.
81' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 16:3.
80' The game has come to an end for Ridle Baku. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) is coming onto the pitch as Tiago Tomas cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj will be replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
77' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) receives a yellow card.
77' Substitution. Marius Wolf makes his way off the pitch and Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
76' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper.
74' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
74' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
74' Felix Brych blows his whistle and it's Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
73' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

72' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the bottom left corner, but Nediljko Labrovic was alert and made an amazing save! The referee blows his whistle, Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
72' The corner kick from Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
72' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Wolfsburg have a corner.
71' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will take a throw-in.
70' Augsburg fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
68' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Lovro Majer limps off the pitch to be replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
66' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg) replaces Alexis Claude-Maurice.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is replacing Phillip Tietz.
63' Felix Brych couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Wolfsburg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

63' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Augsburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
62' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg).
61' Wolfsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
57' Here is a change. Jonas Wind is going off and Ralph Hasenhuttl gives the last tactical orders to Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
57' The substitution has been made. Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) has replaced Kilian Fischer.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolfsburg.
52' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
52' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
50' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
49' A cross from a corner kick by Wolfsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
49' Wolfsburg show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
48' Great teamplay by Augsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
46' Felix Brych blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' None of the Wolfsburg players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The Augsburg players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
43' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
41' Wonderful movement by Wolfsburg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
41' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Wolfsburg will take a corner kick.
39' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' Wolfsburg fail to score from a corner as Nediljko Labrovic (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
34' 0 - 1 Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) goes on mazy run which culminates with a one-on-one with the keeper. He keeps his cool and calmly dispatches the ball into the net.
34' The Augsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
34' A player from Wolfsburg commits a rough challenge. Felix Brych blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
32' Wolfsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

22' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the left post! The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
18' It's a nice effort by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Nediljko Labrovic. Easy save.
14' Augsburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' The linesman signals a throw-in for Wolfsburg.

10' Wolfsburg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
6' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
5' The Wolfsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Augsburg will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Felix Brych.
